question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Array
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Array"** means an impressive display or range of a particular type of thing. (श्रृंखला)

 
 
• **Example: **The store offers an **array** of electronic gadgets.
 
 
 
• **"Unit"** refers to a single thing or person regarded as a single and complete entity. (इकाई)
 
 
• **Example: **Each **unit **in the apartment complex is equipped with modern amenities.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Array' **is **'Unit'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Unit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adorn **(सजाना): To make more beautiful or attractive.

 
 
• **Example:** She likes to adorn her living room with fresh flowers.
 
 
 
• **Cluster **(समूह): A group of similar things or people positioned or occurring closely together.
 
 
• **Example: **A cluster of stars was visible in the night sky.
 
 
 
• **Apparel **(परिधान): Clothing, especially formal.
 
 
• **Example: **Traditional apparel is often worn during cultural festivals.
